title: TensorRT: Scalable, Efficient Deep Learning Inference
description: TensorRT is NVIDIA's inference optimizer: it takes a trained model, performs layer fusion, precision calibration (INT8/FP16 quantization), kernel auto-selection, and generates a highly optimized runtime engine. Inference engines generated by TensorRT run 3–10× faster than the native framework on GPU. It is the production deployment target for most NVIDIA-GPU-based inference systems.
